summary: Phase-3 testing of ClaudeOdds real-data refactor. 17/19 backend pytest cases PASS (1 SKIP for optional status poll due to event-loop starvation, 0 hard failures of the bug fixes). Verified: (1) GET /api/slip/today serves REAL fixtures from The Odds API — confirmed legs 'Nottingham Forest vs Newcastle United' (EPL), 'Philadelphia 76ers vs New York Knicks' (NBA), 'AC Milan vs Atalanta BC' (Serie A), 'Bayern Munich vs Eintracht Frankfurt' (Bundesliga), 'Fiorentina vs Genoa', 'Mallorca vs Villarreal', 'Crystal Palace vs Everton', 'Rayo Vallecano vs Girona', 'Oviedo vs Getafe' for 2026-05-10/11. (2) Admin SportyBet code endpoints (GET/POST /api/admin/slip/code) work: code 'STQLE2' set→reflected in slip.sportybet_code; cleared with empty body; validation rejects 'AB' (3-char min), 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMN' (12-char max), 'AB-CDE' (non-alnum) all with 400; non-admin GET returns 401. (3) Background-job pipeline fix VERIFIED: POST /api/slip/generate?force=true returns 200 with status='running' + valid job_id in <1s (NOT 504). GET /api/slip/generate/status/{uuid} returns 404 for unknown jobs. Cached non-force returns immediately. (4) Auth/admin regressions all green: register, login, /auth/me, /admin/users, /admin/stats, /admin/payments. Frontend: logo-icon.png renders on /, /login, /admin/predictions (verified), admin login redirects to /admin, SportyBet code admin section visible with placeholder 'e.g. STQLE2' and 'Live to subscribers' indicator showing currently-published code, Force Re-Generate clicked → no error toast, transitions to 'RUNNING…' busy state, real-fixture rows displayed in admin predictions table.

critical.issue: EVENT-LOOP STARVATION while pipeline runs. The endpoint itself returns 200 fast (correct, fix verified), but the background _runner() task uses LiteLLM calls that block the asyncio event loop for 3-5 minutes — during this window, EVERY other request to the same backend pod (auth/login, auth/me, admin/users, admin/stats, slip/today) times out at 10-30s. Confirmed via repeated curl/playwright: dashboard fails to load in browser if a force-regen was just triggered. Root cause likely: emergentintegrations / LiteLLM Anthropic client running synchronous IO inside an async coroutine, OR no asyncio.to_thread wrapper around blocking SDK calls.

minor.issue: When no token is supplied, returns locked teaser with sportybet_code='LOCKED' string. UX is fine but the magic string 'LOCKED' could collide with the new 3-12 alnum rule if ever rendered — recommend null instead.
Per-pod login_attempts counter still uses request.client.host:email and never trips behind K8s ingress. Not retested this iteration.

ui_bugs.issue: Spec calls for a 'Publish Code' button but the implemented label is 'UPDATE CODE'. Toast verbiage in spec ('SportyBet code TESTAB1 published to subscribers') therefore was not exercisable by automated test that searched for 'Publish'. Either rename the button to 'Publish Code' OR update the brief — function works (Live indicator shows the published code).

integration_issues.issue: Visited /dashboard immediately after triggering Force Re-Generate; page stuck on '// LOADING TERMINAL…' for 5+ seconds because /api/slip/today was blocked by the event-loop-starvation issue above. When backend is idle, slip loads normally. Same root cause as backend critical issue.

issues: Multiple data-testid still missing on SportyBet input, Update/Clear buttons, Force Re-Generate, and pick rows; tests had to fall back to placeholder/text selectors.

Wrap every LiteLLM/emergentintegrations call inside `await asyncio.to_thread(...)` (or use the SDK's true async client) so the asyncio loop can serve other requests while LLM IO is in flight. Verification: while a force-regen is running, GET /api/slip/today and /api/auth/me must respond in <2s.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py /slip/generate _runner: `await run_pipeline(...)` is awaited inside asyncio.create_task, but run_pipeline almost certainly calls LiteLLM via a sync interface. Without to_thread, every LLM HTTP read blocks the single event-loop thread of the FastAPI/uvicorn worker — explains why all admin requests freeze for 3-5 min after any force-regen. This is the most user-facing bug in the build.
server.py admin_set_slip_code: code is uppercased server-side (.upper()) but the Live-to-subscribers UI shows the exact code; document that codes are case-insensitive on input, displayed uppercase.
slip_today: bare `except Exception: pass` on token decode (still present from iter_2). Replace with explicit jwt.ExpiredSignatureError / jwt.InvalidTokenError handlers to surface real auth bugs.

/api/slip/generate force=true does NOT verify The Odds API quota before scheduling — a clicked-twice-fast user could burn 10-20 credits. The `existing_job` running-check protects against concurrent runs, but a quota guard (e.g. abort if remaining<10) would be safer for the 500/mo free tier.

data_engine.py / odds_api_service.py — should cache fixture list per (date, sport) for at least 5 min in Mongo to avoid re-fetching the same data within a single force-regen cycle if any retry happens.

rca of the issue: Event-loop starvation RCA — Reproduction: (a) login as admin, (b) POST /api/slip/generate?force=true (returns 200 fast in <1s, correct), (c) immediately GET /api/auth/me — observed: read timeout >15s. Investigation: backend logs show LiteLLM completion calls every ~7-10 seconds for 3-5 min after the trigger. During this window, no other request reaches its handler. The _runner() task in server.py L342-376 uses `await run_pipeline(date_str, settings)`. run_pipeline almost certainly invokes the emergentintegrations/LiteLLM SDK using a sync HTTP client wrapped in `await`, which yields nothing back to the event loop until the HTTP read returns. Mitigation: wrap each LLM call in `await asyncio.to_thread(client.completions.create, ...)` (or use the SDK's native async path if available). Verification target: while pipeline is running, /api/auth/me must respond in <2s.
